I don't have the benchmark table, so these are priors from general training dynamics, not measured effects. Most interaction claims need a consistent, practically meaningful effect across all three datasets, which is a strict bar, so I've kept most values low. Where a mechanism suggests the effect is probably negative under the condition, I've scored it low.
